name: Microlyte+
summary: Ion-selective electrolyte analyzer for Na⁺, K⁺, Ca⁺⁺ and Cl⁻, also available in Na⁺/K⁺/Ca⁺⁺, Na⁺/K⁺/Cl⁻ and Na⁺/K⁺ configurations. Results in 60 seconds from 110 µL of whole blood, serum or plasma, with a 7" colour touch screen, RFID reagent packs and maintenance-free electrodes.

specs.label: Urine precision
specs.value: Within-run CV (20 samples): Na⁺ ≤ 6.4%, K⁺ ≤ 5.0%, Cl⁻ ≤ 5.0%

specs.label: Sample types
specs.value: Whole blood, serum, plasma, urine, CSF

specs.label: Sample volume
specs.value: 110 µL whole blood, serum or plasma; 150 µL capillary; 400 µL diluted (1:4) urine

specs.label: Analysis time
specs.value: 60 s for whole blood, serum, plasma or CSF; 120 s for urine

specs.label: Data storage
specs.value: More than 25,000 test results on SD card (8 – 32 GB)

specs.label: Printer
specs.value: Built-in thermal graphic printer, 57 mm paper, easy loading

specs.label: Controls
specs.value: 3 levels per test: low, normal and high

features: Easy icon-based operation on a 7" colour touch screen
Automatic or programmable calibration every 2, 4 or 6 hours
Liquid-stable reagents with built-in RFID reagent management
Easy access to the electrode assembly
Colour-coded flags for low, normal and high results
Individual reagent packs to optimise cost per test
